name: openviewer-page-flip
description: Vendored + patched StPageFlip (page-flip) ESM build. Patches: Flip.stopMove always completes a released USER_FOLD fold from its current position, the built-in spine shadow is widened to overlap its gradients more closely, the spine (crease) shadow is only drawn in landscape spreads so a single page has no gutter shadow, image onload handlers are registered before source assignment to avoid loader flashes, usePortrait stays a single page even when the canvas is wider than two pages, the portrait frame clip is not applied so a page curl can draw into the spare page on either side, and each page is drawn contained in the leaf with its margin color behind it so the bitmap is never cropped.
